answer_1.quote: We evaluate the visual question answering abilities of ChatVLA using Vlmevalkit (Duan et al., 2024) on TextVQA , DocVQA , InfoVQA , AI2D , ChartQA , MTVQA , and Real-worldQA .

answer_2.quote: ChatVLA demonstrates competitive performance relative to existing VLMs across multiple benchmarks. Notably, in VQA tasks, our framework achieves a notable performance of 71.2 on TextVQA, surpassing current SOTA VLAs by substantial margins.
